name: Tax Executive Summary — Should NOT Trigger

queries_that_should_not_trigger_this_ski.query: Give me the executive summary of the Rileys' revocable trust
What would they owe if David converts $200k to a Roth this year?
Show me 2026 for the Rileys with the new tax law updates
Who's the trustee under the Riley trust?
Are they on track with withholding for 2026, or will they owe at filing?

success_criteria: Zero calls to get_lookback_report, get_extraction_form, get_federal_tax_constants, or get_state_tax_constants for any of these queries
Each query is either answered by the correct skill's territory or, if this skill briefly loads, is handed off explicitly in the first sentence with no data pulled
must_not: producing a tax executive summary in response to any of these queries
silently answering an estate, balance-sheet, or forward-looking modeling question with filed-return data
